description: Header file defining the DwarfCUToModule class and related classes for processing DWARF debugging information and populating a google_breakpad::Module. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and comments explaining their purpose.

classes.name: DwarfCUToModule
classes.description: Class responsible for processing DWARF debugging info and populating a Module with source, function, and line info.

classes.name: DwarfCUToModule::FileContext
classes.description: Holds global information for a DWARF-bearing file, used by DwarfCUToModule.

classes.name: DwarfCUToModule::LineToModuleHandler
classes.description: Abstract interface for handling DWARF line data for a compilation unit.

classes.name: DwarfCUToModule::WarningReporter
classes.description: Interface for reporting warnings and issues encountered during DWARF processing.

methods.name: EndAttributes
methods.description: Ends attribute processing for a DIE.

methods.name: FindChildHandler
methods.description: Finds a handler for a child DIE based on offset and tag.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Assigns lines to functions and adds them to the module.

methods.name: StartCompilationUnit
methods.description: Begins processing a compilation unit with given parameters.

methods.name: SetLanguage
methods.description: Sets the source language for the compilation unit.

methods.name: ReadSourceLines
methods.description: Reads source line info from a given offset in the debug line section.

methods.name: AssignLinesToFunctions
methods.description: Distributes source lines to corresponding functions.
